data: Really smooth program to operate. Seamlessly backs up my saves enough so when my mates decide to mess with my factory, I can reset the game pretty quickly. 10/10 hours saved.

First of all, I’m glad this software is free. I just gave it a quick try and found that it’s pretty much on par with Steam Cloud—it works with almost any game. The only difference is that it supports many platforms, such as GOG, Epic, and others, but I believe most players…

Very useful save management tool between friends, already saved us money from renting a dedicated server, even when your mate decides to remove something they shouldn't, we just rolled back to the version that didn't require fixing it. 10/10!
Думал можно будет переносить сохранки с SteamDeck на пк и наоборот, но увы. На SteamDeck прога не работает. А так задумка хорошая.
I love this software. It lets me share my worlds between friends and my husband.
